items.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
items.description: Martial law has been in place in Ukraine since February 2022, under which elections are suspended.

items.title: Mushroom murderer trial undermined by 'catastrophic' hotel mix-up, appeal court told
items.description: Erin Patterson's defence team appeal against her conviction for killing relatives with a beef Wellington laced with toxic mushrooms.

items.title: Trump pauses new tariffs on Canada for three days, saying deal close
items.description: The US president says the two sides are finalising documents to avert import taxes targeting a range of Canadian goods.

items.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
items.description: It comes after Trump announced plans to curtail joint military exercises with South Korea, citing a "very good" relationship with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.

items.title: Apparent human remains found in US reservoir as water levels hit record low
items.description: The skeletal remains in Lake Mead include what appears to be a human jaw with teeth attached, a witness says.

items.title: Meta hooked children on Facebook and Instagram, US court hears
items.description: Meta argued social media addiction does not exist, as a trial stemming from a major lawsuit brought by US states started.

items.title: Liberia agrees to accept 1,200 foreign deportees from the US
items.description: Liberia says the deal is a "humanitarian arrangement" and is receiving no compensation.
